description.value: Italian Tomato is a sit-down Italian restaurant in Richmond with over a decade of experience serving traditional dishes like lasagna and cannelloni. It offers a highly customizable pasta menu with 12 pasta types and 39 freshly-made sauces, plus thin-crust pizza made with house-made dough and San Marzano tomatoes. Takeout and delivery are available alongside dine-in service, making it a potential meal stop for cyclists in the Bridgeport Road corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant's address (8380 Bridgeport Road, Richmond), phone ((604) 247-0040), and that it offers eat-in, takeout, and delivery. Several catering menu items are marked with asterisks as vegetarian. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating restaurant with takeout and vegetarian options, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact would be needed to verify before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering inquiries use a separate phone number (604-767-8592) and email (italiantomato_restaurant@yahoo.ca) found on the /catering subpage, which differ from the main contact details.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Catering menu marks multiple items as vegetarian with an asterisk, including Pomodoro, Primavera, Portofino, Alfredo, and Pesto sauces. No explicit vegan or gluten-free claims found
